_why: The Arms redesign is a parry engine and the premade build buys none of it.
Four talents feed parry and two spend it, and the premade takes Small
Victories at 0/5 -- which also makes Riposte unreachable, since Riposte
requires 5 points in it. This build buys the whole chain:
Small Victories 5/5   (T0.1) +5% parry, and each parry has a 50% chance
to grant Victorious, enabling Victory Rush -- which
now heals 20% of maximum health and works in every
stance. This is Arms' self-healing.
Riposte 3/3           (T1.1) parrying counter-attacks every enemy within
8 yards for 60% weapon damage on a 3 second
internal cooldown. Passive; the rotation's job is
just to keep parry high.
Hobble 3/3            (T5.2) Hamstring with a two-hander grants 10%
parry for 10 seconds. The rotation's one active
parry button.
Weapon Mastery 1/2 -> 2/2  (T5.0) parry from Strength.
Two-Handed Weapon Specialization is already taken and already converts 60%
of critical strike into parry, so it needed nothing.
Funded by the 8-point Protection dip -- Toughness and Anticipation, armour
and dodge, which a build stacking parry and Riposte counters does not need
a second source of -- and by Cruelty 5/5 -> 1/5 in Fury. Armored to the
Teeth stays: it converts armour to attack power, which is the one part of
the dip that compounds with the rest of this build.
67 Arms / 4 Fury.
